strategy.brief: Product Identity by Trigenys gives every physical product unit a unique digital identity. Brands can generate serial numbers and QR codes, let customers verify authenticity and register ownership/warranty, and unify product identity across Shopify, Amazon, retail and distributor channels. Initial target: DTC hardware and durable-goods brands selling serialized, warrantied or counterfeit-sensitive products. The product must be self-service, international-first, privacy-aware, secure by default, and designed for later Shopify App Store distribution.
